description: Sieve Schema Contract v1 conformance corpus. Canonical copy lives in sieve-lens tests/corpus/; replicas in other Sieve tools' test suites are pinned by sha256. Each tool runs the layers it implements: 'json' cases need the strict JSON layer (violations tags: dup_key / nan_inf / bom; tools without a layer skip the tagged case), 'schema' cases need the validator. error_pointer is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer pinned for reject cases that have one.
